decisions.summary: A part carries its own data-kind on the sheet; no side list.
decisions.why: FR-001 as written; 262's nearest-tag reader already yields the part's kind.

decisions.summary: The reader derives part-of from the drawing's nesting (every distinct tagged ancestor kind); a part drawn outside its parent's group for paint order declares data-part-of, read as an enclosing group; flatten() keeps its shape.
decisions.why: FR-003 and the spec's Part-of declaration entity, which define a part as one inside its parent's group or declared part of it. Lineage is transitive, which is what US2 asks (the residence lights every room, the veranda, the corridor, the genkan). Read in sheet.py: data-part-of joins the lineage exactly as a tagged ancestor does.

decisions.summary: render_page gains within= (default None); wrapped groups carry data-in; page.js files a group under every key its data-in names.
decisions.why: FR-003 both halves: the kitchen's highlight takes the hearth; the hearth's own key is unchanged, so it lights no kitchen. The default None path leaves every hamlet caller's strings byte-identical (FR-008). One correction to the plan's wording, not a narrowing: page.js is inlined into every page (page.py _asset('page.js')), so a regenerated hamlet page's script text grows by the inert data-in branch; the hamlet pages carry no data-in, so what they draw, their census (SC-005's measure of FR-008) and their behavior are unchanged.

decisions.summary: A labeled room is drawn as its own fill in the building's color between the building's fill and its outline; the shuttered wing is tagged as is.
decisions.why: FR-002 with FR-006, and the spec's Decisions Recorded row naming this as the way a room's floor can light. The PNG identity is T02's to measure per sheet (SC-004).

decisions.summary: The pack audit folds a rect of a building's own fill wholly inside an earlier building rect into that building (rooms_folded).
decisions.why: It narrows the audit's reach (a same-fill rect contained in a building is no longer audited as a building of its own), so it is ruled rather than waved through. It follows from the spec's own words: FR-002 forces the rooms as rects (D4, the spec's Decisions Recorded), and FR-006 requires the audit to report the same findings; unfolded, the room rects make the audit report gaps between a building's own rooms. Measured this review by make pack-audit, HEAD in a detached worktree against the working tree: output identical on all six precinct sheets (Ochiba, Hayakawa, Ubame, Hoshigaoka shrine, the two generated sheets); the working-tree audit run on the HEAD sheets equals the HEAD audit, so the fold changes nothing on any sheet drawn before this feature; the HEAD audit on the new sheets gains Ochiba 'LOOSE 13.3 ft at svg(800,509)' and Ubame 'LOOSE 17.3 ft at svg(334,503)' and loses one 'fire-gap OK (kura)' line, all artifacts of the room rects. It hides no finding: every audit consumer of plan.buildings (nearest-building distance, tub overlap, floating doors, the occupancy grid) reads the same union with or without a contained same-fill rect, the fold only removes spurious aligned gaps and room-edge door readings, and no check ever reported one building contained in another (occluded_foreground exempts containment explicitly). The plan's 'Ubame +2/-1' is stale against this run, which shows +1/-1; the ruling does not depend on it.

decisions.summary: The placer draws the practice ground's rack and posts as parts inside a group of the ground's kind.
decisions.why: The spec's edge case on the two placer-drawn sheets and FR-001/FR-003; read in compound.py.

decisions.summary: New kinds in the existing family modules from coverage.md; parents' Covers and prose trimmed; court divider and nakamon split; an over-long module is split.
decisions.why: FR-001 (the nakamon named there), FR-004, FR-005; the file split is the standing 1,000-line rule.

decisions.summary: Uncovered kinds and contradictions go to future-work/compounds.md Research owed; no research pass.
decisions.why: FR-004 and US3 as written, the GM's 2026-09-26 instruction.

decisions.summary: Verification by a hand-run browser probe over the five pages (SC-001, SC-002) written into research.md; unit tests for the reader, the page and the registry; no browser test over a rolled page.
decisions.why: The spec's SC-001 and SC-002 name a probe, not a standing browser test, so nothing the spec asked for is cut; the unit tests of T08 add enforcement and are not unrequested. The probe covers FR-009 (a point naming each parent and its modal) as SC-001 requires.
